t: This is The Drinker, a 2004 statue by the street artist Banksy. It takes Rodin's famous sculpture The Thinker and puts a traffic cone on its head, turning a symbol of deep thought into something much more cheeky. Banksy is the anonymous England-based artist known for satirical work that mixes dark humour with political comment. His art grew out of the Bristol underground scene, and he has never publicly confirmed who he is.
